---
applyTo: "app/_components/**/*.tsx"
description: "Use when editing React components: keep components small, reuse existing patterns, and include short Slovak comments for junior developers"
---

# React Components Instructions

- Keep components small, focused, and easy to read.
- Reuse existing components and project patterns before creating new ones.
- Use clear prop names and straightforward component structure.
- Add a short Slovak comment above every new component explaining what it does.
- Add short Slovak comments above non-obvious UI or state logic to explain why it exists.
- Do not comment obvious lines.
- Keep Tailwind classes readable and aligned with existing project visual style.
- Avoid introducing a new visual system when current patterns already solve the problem.
